claim_boundary: This prompt is a reproducible benchmark handoff artifact. It is not evidence that a Codex-authenticated run succeeded or rediscovered the 25-comparator target.
prompt:
Run the LibreEvolve sorting_network_9 benchmark candidate from a clean checkout using the tracked Codex CLI profile.

Use model/auth lane: gpt-5.3-codex-spark through config.yaml backend type codex with auth_name current. Do not add secrets to the repository, do not change benchmark targets, and do not edit the validator to make the task easier.

Command:
py -3.12 -m libreevolve run libreevolve/problems/examples/sorting_network_9 --run-name sorting_network_9_codex_spark_clean_checkout --max-generations 20 --proposals-per-generation 1 --overwrite

Objective: improve the seed 9-input sorting network. The evaluator checks all 512 binary inputs using the zero-one principle. The target evidence condition is a valid network with comparator_count <= 25 and target_achieved == 1.0. Preserve all generated run artifacts under runs/sorting_network_9_codex_spark_clean_checkout and the Codex CLI transcript directory named by config.yaml.

After the run, inspect manifest.json, history.jsonl, evaluator_results.jsonl, llm_calls.jsonl, prompt_history.jsonl, best.py, best_workspace, and transcript JSON files. Report whether the target was reached, the best comparator_count/depth/score, the best artifact hashes, any provider/auth/timeout failures, and whether repeated-run certification is still missing. Keep the claim boundary explicit: this single run is not AlphaEvolve-comparable paper evidence without repeated seeds, source citations, redacted transcript/hash retention, and certification rows.
